title: A lane posts a review round's record before any push to its PR branch, a base merge included
why: A lane pushed a base merge before it printed a review round's record, so the record could not name the reviewed head (coordinator, 04:26 CST Nov 8). Step record-before-fix-push covers a fix push after a passing round only.
note: Fix: the push guard asks on any push to a PR branch whose newest review round has no posted record, a base-merge push included. Red case first: a base-merge push before the record passes today; control: a push after the record is posted passes. Related steps record-before-fix-push (#1538) and record-after-each-round. Lane session_013NEJL1Umc5vUUPV286bXnV. Queue fix. Filed 04:30 CST Nov 8. Sighting (lane builder-report-in-head, 06:58 CST Nov 8; filed as record-before-later-push, folded here): the lane pushed after review passed and before the record was posted; merge --review-record records only the live head, so the record could not be written, and nothing stopped the push. Four more sightings, one mistake (a fix pushed before the failed round's record was posted, so the tool could not record the old head): #1985 (lane notes-fix-other-2), #1699 (lane sim-lease-gaps), #1914 at 05:06 CST (lane notes-fix-large-3; proposed post-fail-record-first, folded here), and #1958's rounds. Coordinator, 07:43 CST Nov 8: one home, no second step review-record-past-head. Two more sightings, folded here at 09:44 CST Nov 8 (triage had filed them as a duplicate step, record-at-round-head, now removed): lane bg-tail-loses-verdict on #2015 and #2025 (round 3 not recorded at its head before fixes landed, so `merge --review-record --fix-check` refused; harm: runner 8 gets a record it may not parse, or a lane fakes the head); lane notes-fix-report on #2026 and #2068 at 09:40 CST (a fresh chain of three rounds followed). Second guard idea from bg-tail: `--fix-check` takes the reviewed head named in the reviewer's report; that touches step fix-check-chain.
